statement: Functional evidence only. No hosted, VM, SSH, broker sandbox, futures smoke, live order, real capital or model provider call was exercised. Hosted verification belongs to INSTRUMENT-EXPRESSION-HOSTED-ACCEPTANCE-20261107.

commands.result: 15 passed (incl. forged/no-position/wrong-side/oversized close_leg rejection and opposite-holding scan in both position orders)
commands.covers: acceptance 1-4: pure decide, dev plan 4.4 worked outcomes on Date=20261106 fixtures (2330 SHORT gross_limit; 0050 SHORT chooses ssf:SRF:202611 sell 1; 2317 SHORT no_feasible; 2330 LONG 0.2 eq:2330 buy 1; 0050 LONG 0.9 chooses ssf:SRF:202611 x2 over eq:0050 x1081 and ssf:NYF:202611), 1000-call and cross-process determinism, absent strength, close_leg, already_at_target, malformed decider rejected with instrument_not_in_candidates

commands.result: 524 passed, 49 subtests passed (re-run after review round 2)
commands.covers: acceptance 5-7: flag off/legacy artifact/non-Taiwan symbol keep today's decision_id and signal_id and dict; flag on chooses cash or future with the envelope (instrument_id, kind, units, multiplier, reason_code, decision_id); NoTrade becomes HOLD noop (paper_order_simulated noop_count 1 with the record) and a restart does not retry the bar; decision persisted before enqueue; restart after persistence before fill reuses stored instrument and units; chosen stock_future rejected with instrument_not_supported_by_ledger and no fill; signal_generation carries strength/momentum/view_direction, trade_decision carries the record; compose default PANTHEON_PAPER_EXPRESSION_LAYER off

review_fixes: enforce() validates close_leg against trusted book holdings (same instrument, reducing side, units <= held); otherwise rejected with instrument_not_in_candidates; producer end-to-end regression added (TestExpressionDecisionStep.test_forged_close_leg_without_a_holding_cannot_place_an_order)
decide() scans opposite-direction holdings before the same-direction already_at_target no-op; tested in both orderings

Round 2 P1: the strategy now attaches a lazy expression evaluator; PaperSignalProducer.produce evaluates candidates/decider only after admission and a stored-record lookup miss, so a restart replays the persisted record without builder or decider. Tests: test_restart_after_persist_before_enqueue_replays_without_builder_or_decider, test_consumed_no_trade_skips_without_builder_or_decider
Round 2 P2: enforce() rejects price/margin fields before the NoTrade early return; test_forbidden_field_on_no_trade_record_is_rejected covers price and initial_margin_per_unit
design_notes: Producer inputs persona_book and risk_budget are read from binding metadata expression_inputs (or an injected provider); absent inputs fail closed to a NoTrade. No ledger reader exists in the producer yet, so production wiring of these inputs is left to the later ledger/gate task.

The normalized SSF dataset root is read from PANTHEON_TAIFEX_SSF_NORMALIZED_ROOT; it is not mounted in compose by this task, so until then the futures candidates are unavailable and only cash shares are candidates.
The cash candidate price is the D-1 close the signal context already carries (closes[-1]); no price is read from anywhere else.
The layer runs only for Taiwan-venue symbols; other symbols keep the legacy path.
No telemetry event type was added; only metadata description in telemetry_event.schema.json was extended.
